## Website Developer Workflow

- Treat this as a static bilingual portfolio website hosted at `https://ayman.de5.net/`.
- Use `README.md` as the main developer workflow and pre-publish checklist.
- Keep the Arabic homepage in `index.html` as the primary page, and keep the English version in `index-en.html` aligned with it.
- When changing content, update matching SEO metadata, structured data, visible copy, image alt text, and `llms.txt` if the service facts change.
- Preserve the main conversion paths: WhatsApp contact, phone contact, and the Calendly consultation link.
- Before publishing, check desktop and mobile layouts, navigation anchors, portfolio lightbox behavior, lead form validation, WhatsApp message generation, and external links.
- Keep `robots.txt` allowing the site and `/llms.txt`; update sitemap or canonical references only if the domain or URL structure changes.
- Use optimized images in the `images/` folder and keep descriptive alt text for portfolio and profile assets.
- Do not add unsupported claims such as guaranteed rankings, guaranteed sales, office branches, team members, or unlisted services.
